verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents Batch Sending: one API call can address many recipients, with per-recipient Recipient Variables, and it supports Mailing Lists with Template Variables. That is a real first-party bulk operation, but the evidence covers only bulk sending, not bulk operations across other items. Missing for 10: bulk management of other resources (e.g. suppressions, list members, email validation), documented batch limits and behavior, and bulk actions through the MCP/AI-native interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
